pages:checkout.title: Checkout
pages:checkout.description: A complete checkout flow with account and billing details, a saved payment choice, clear renewal consent, persistent order summary, and inline completion feedback.

pages:order-confirmation.title: Order Confirmation
pages:order-confirmation.description: Post-purchase success screen with order summary, email confirmation, estimated delivery, and order tracking actions.

pages:loyalty-program-dashboard.title: Loyalty Program Dashboard
pages:loyalty-program-dashboard.description: Customer rewards interface showing tier progress, redeemable benefits, points balance, and earning opportunities.

pages:shopping-cart-with-summary.title: Shopping Cart
pages:shopping-cart-with-summary.description: A complete cart page with a flat ruled item list, the shared quantity control, and one pastel order-summary rail.

pages:wishlist-manager.title: Saved Items
pages:wishlist-manager.description: A complete saved-items page with a flat comparable list, stock state, cart and remove actions, and the shared empty state.
